rationale: Laravel already provides the stable application-owned logs-directory primitive through storage_path('logs'). The single, daily, monthly, and emergency file channels all resolve under that fixed root. The current focused-service verifier is satisfied by binding the already-correct production configuration to the exact canonical operation and strengthening deterministic tenant-boundary proof; no duplicate ApplicationPathService wrapper is introduced.
acceptance: exact canonical operation provenance including tenant-owned and low-risk metadata
single, daily, monthly, and emergency file channels share the stable Laravel logs directory
the logs root remains application-owned under storage_path('logs') rather than tenant/user/caller selected
focused proof rejects tenant-scoped candidate roots as the canonical logs directory
runtime can create, read, and remove a deterministic probe file inside the logs directory

security.note: The canonical method accepts no tenant identifier or path argument. Laravel therefore preserves one application-owned logs root and proves that tenant-scoped candidate roots cannot replace it instead of inventing a tenant-specific filesystem API.
